At exact phase boundaries resolver uses half-open phase and palms remain all; center must be continuous from parent boundary validation. Guard dynamic palms keys with own enumerable key checks and no mutation, __proto__ is legal only if actual own data property; do not insert keys into ordinary {} accumulators. notes: Only packages/director/ownership-bake.ts is proposed. No tools, tests, callback execution or runtime integration were performed.

The proposal preserves the original global clock, source-anchored fps grid, original phase boundaries and validated supplied breakpoints. It neither changes source geometry nor synthesizes ownership, contact or cues.

Resolved records are copied and validated, including exact requested times, every original palm, duplicate-free exact active-grip membership and explicit phase authority. Palm storage has a null prototype; __proto__ is accepted only as an actual own enumerable data property.

The conservative 12,000-frame ceiling counts all distinct resolved times, including probe-only records. Refinement permits depth-12 leaves but rejects further splitting, exhausted budgets and intervals without distinct representable probe times.
maxMeasuredGapPx reports center/all-palm interpolation gaps at the three probes of final retained intervals only. It is sampled candidate evidence, not mathematical proof of continuous correctness.
concerns: The parent must supply complete original actor compiler breakpoints and an actual resolver that independently validates original geometry, world/contact anchors, transitions and center continuity at boundaries. This module cannot establish those properties from returned samples alone.

Because probe-only records count toward the conservative frame budget, a slice can fail closed even when its emitted sample count would be below 12,000. No partial result, relaxed threshold or fallback is provided.

One-entity renderer/depth/actor integration, validation and tests remain parent-owned. needs-source-prop-binding and all source, actor, contact, art, motion, voice and production gates remain unchanged; both approval-related output flags remain false.
